content.user_title: Track SEO Rankings and SERP Movement
content.value_statement: Ranking movement is hard to interpret when baselines, sources, and SERP features are mixed. This skill builds source-labeled rank snapshots, compares deltas, and turns changes into SEO actions.
actual_capabilities: Configures keyword tracking by domain, market, device, language, priority, and competitor set.
Compares current positions against baselines and labels gains, drops, new rankings, and lost rankings.
Tracks SERP feature ownership, including snippets, People Also Ask, image packs, video packs, and local packs.
Reviews AI visibility signals such as AI Overview presence, citation rate, and citation position when data is available.
Labels every metric as measured, user-provided, or estimated to prevent unsupported claims.
Produces ranking reports with wins, concerns, likely causes, and next actions.
limitations: It cannot fetch paid SEO tool data unless the host provides a connected tool or export.
It does not replace recurring monitoring, alerting, or multi-metric stakeholder reporting.
Ranking data can vary by location, device, search personalization, and tool methodology.
Causal explanations remain hypotheses unless supported by separate technical, content, or competitive evidence.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Ranking Drops
use_cases.description: Compare recent keyword positions with a baseline and identify likely decline patterns for priority pages.

use_cases.title: Prepare Weekly Search Updates
use_cases.description: Create a concise rank movement summary with wins, concerns, SERP feature shifts, and next actions.

use_cases.title: Monitor AI Search Visibility
use_cases.description: Track whether target pages appear in AI Overviews and whether the brand receives citations for key topics.

prompt_templates.title: Start Basic Tracking
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a domain and keyword list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up rank tracking for my domain using these keywords. Include market, device, priority, target URL, and a first baseline snapshot.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Ranking Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze ranking changes for this domain between these two exports. Show biggest gains, biggest drops, new rankings, lost rankings, and likely next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Review SERP Feature Ownership
prompt_templates.prompt: Review SERP feature ownership for these tracked keywords. Include featured snippets, People Also Ask, local packs, image packs, and competitor owners.

prompt_templates.title: Run Competitive GEO Analysis
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced report covering competitors and AI visibility.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a ranking and GEO visibility report for this domain against these competitors. Include source labels, AI citation checks, share of voice, risks, and recommendations.

output_examples.input: Track 40 priority keywords for a B2B software domain.
output_examples.output: A setup summary with market, device, keyword groups, target URLs, competitor domains, baseline positions, source labels, and tracking frequency.

output_examples.input: Analyze last month of ranking changes from two exports.
output_examples.output: A movement summary showing the overall trend, top gains, top declines, new rankings, lost rankings, likely causes, and recovery priorities.

output_examples.input: Check AI visibility for product comparison terms.
output_examples.output: A GEO visibility view listing AI Overview presence, brand citation status, citation position, observed content gaps, and follow-up actions.

best_practices: Provide a keyword list, target domain, market, device, language, and baseline date before asking for movement analysis.
Use measured exports or Search Console data when available, and label user-provided or estimated values clearly.
Review drops against competitors, SERP feature changes, and technical signals before assigning a cause.
anti_patterns: Do not treat one-day position changes as proof of success or failure.
Do not compare rankings from different locations, devices, or tools without noting methodology differences.
Do not present estimated positions, traffic, or AI citations as measured data.

faq.question: Can this skill fetch rankings automatically?
faq.answer: Only when the host provides an SEO tool, Search Console export, analytics source, or approved connector. Otherwise it uses user-provided data.

faq.question: Does it create alerts?
faq.answer: No. It can identify important movement, but recurring reports and alerts belong in the performance-monitor skill.

faq.question: Can it track AI Overviews?
faq.answer: Yes, when AI visibility data is measured or provided. If data is unavailable, it marks those fields as not available.

faq.question: How does it handle missing baselines?
faq.answer: It records the current run as the first snapshot and avoids inventing prior positions.

faq.question: Can it explain why rankings changed?
faq.answer: It can provide likely hypotheses based on available signals. Confirmed causes require supporting evidence from technical, content, or competitor analysis.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.
